fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run 'TestWebTokenNoneSetRefusesEveryPost|TestWebTokenWrongOrMissingRefused|TestWebTokenCookieAfterQueryVisit|TestWebTokenBearerAccepted|TestWebTokenActionsOn' shows every POST refused when no token is set, a POST refused with a wrong or missing token, the cookie set after a ?token= visit, and a bearer header accepted; go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestWebTokenSetting shows daemon.set accepts rhiza.web.token, the daemon's web handler (web_root.go) gates POSTs on the token it reads from that setting, and neither daemon.settings nor an unauthenticated GET /api/daemon.settings through WebProjectHandler returns the token's value.
fields.statement: A web token (rhiza.web.token, set with rhiza daemon set and read by the daemon's web handler) turns on the web UI's actions: a browser presents it once with ?token= and keeps it in an HttpOnly cookie, a script sends it as a bearer header; the token's value is never shown, so daemon.settings and the web UI's read-only API (GET /api/daemon.settings) report only whether it is set; without a token set, pages show no action controls and every POST is refused, and pages stay readable as today.
